Install roster members from the r-universe and CRAN repositories

Source: R/cao_install.R
cao_install.Rd

Installs the requested roster members, one at a time, so that one unavailable or still-private member never stops the rest of the install. Every outcome – already installed, freshly installed, failed, or unavailable – is reported per member; the function itself never raises an error for a member it could not install.

Usage

cao_install(
  members = "all",
  repos = c(runiverse = "https://max578.r-universe.dev", CRAN =
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"),
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

members

Either a length-one character scalar naming a tier ("core", "supporting", or "all", the default), or an explicit character vector of package names (need not be limited to the roster – "orchestraManifest" is a legitimate extra name).

repos

A named character vector of repository URLs passed to utils::install.packages(). Defaults to the max578 r-universe mirror followed by CRAN, so a package available on either resolves.

dry_run

Logical scalar. When TRUE, no installation is attempted and the resolved install plan is returned instead.

Value

When dry_run = TRUE, a data.frame with columns member and repos (the plan, not yet executed). Otherwise, invisibly, a data.frame with columns member, repos, and result (one of "already_installed", "installed", "failed", "unavailable").

See also

cao_roster(), cao_check()

Other roster: cao_check(), cao_roster(), cao_status(), cao_versions()

Author

Max Moldovan, max.moldovan@adelaide.edu.au

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
cao_install(members = "core", dry_run = TRUE)
}
